<h1 id="vocadbweb-activityentryapi">ActivityEntryApi</h1>

## get/api/activityEntries

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/api/activityEntries \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /api/activityEntries`

<h3 id="getapiactivityentries-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|before|query|string(date-time)|false|none|
|since|query|string(date-time)|false|none|
|userId|query|integer(int32)|false|none|
|editEvent|query|[EntryEditEvent](#schemaentryeditevent)|false|none|
|entryType|query|[EntryType](#schemaentrytype)|false|none|
|maxResults|query|integer(int32)|false|none|
|getTotalCount|query|boolean|false|none|
|fields|query|[ActivityEntryOptionalFields](#schemaactivityentryoptionalfields)|false|none|
|entryFields|query|[EntryOptionalFields](#schemaentryoptionalfields)|false|none|
|lang|query|[ContentLanguagePreference](#schemacontentlanguagepreference)|false|none|
|sortRule|query|[ActivityEntrySortRule](#schemaactivityentrysortrule)|false|none|

```bash
curl https://example.com/api/songs/0/ratings \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```
